events.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to watch for?
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — if you spot any screws, duct tape, or spare paint, let me know. I’ve got a bad habit of missing things, so I really appreciate the help.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint, and I’ll let you know right away if I find any.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you check what supplies we already have and note anything we still need for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’ve already got and make a note of anything we still need.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Cleo: So far, I’m still confirming helpers, and Ira said he’d ask around while he’s out running errands. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear back from anyone.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — if you spot any extra screws, tape, or spare tools, that’d help a lot. I might miss things, so I appreciate you keeping an eye out.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint, and I’ll let you know if I find anything else we need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’s perfect—thank you, Cleo! I’ll show up Saturday with a basic tool kit and I’ll head over early so I don’t miss the organizers.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Cleo: That sounds great, Tess — I’ll keep tracking the supplies and let you know if I spot anything else we need for Saturday.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — I’m on supply watch for the repair drive. Tell me what you need checked, and I’ll keep an eye out for it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — that helps a lot. I’ll keep tracking what we have and what’s still needed for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: Hi Leo — I’m keeping an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint for the repair drive. If you need anything else tracked, just let me know.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo — that’s perfect. I don’t need anything else tracked right now.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I find any of those supplies.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what still needs doing.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep tracking what tools and supplies we still need. If you can list what you’re bringing, I’ll note the rest for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Gus: I can help coordinate around school pickup times if that makes the repair drive easier. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, I’m still trying to catch up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Cleo: Thanks for checking in, Nell — we’re still getting our list together, and I’m asking around about what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Nell: Got it — I can help spread the word if you want. Just let me know what supplies or volunteers you still need.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Faye: I’m still keeping an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint for the repair drive. If you hear of any extra supplies, let me know right away.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep watch for anything extra and let you know right away.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep checking for those supplies and let you know if I find anything.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and repeat what’s still needed if anyone asks.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. If you hear anyone asking, please send them my way so I can note what supplies are still needed.
events.speaker: Cleo
